raw_comment:
When observing this graph, I noticed that states in the middle of the country such as Wyoming, Nebraska, Oklahoma and Texas had the most severe droughts.

I wonder if the drought heavily affected climate conditions in central states. Recently this drought has created forest fires throughout New York, so there are likely more intense fires in areas with more severe drought.

This graph relates to me and my community because the lack of rain in recent months has caused multiple fires in New York and other northeastern states. This can also affect the air quality in affected regions.

Headline: Drought Intensifies in Central US
